Trails.Name: Lost in the Woods (Lower) Uphill Route
Lost in the Woods (Upper) Uphill Route

_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
Saturday, November 14, 2026 6:30 AM – Fresh snow and a delayed start kick off this Saturday. We picked up 9 to 13 inches of new snow in the last 24 hours with more on the way this weekend, and the skies have cleared to sunshine and lighter winds. Broadway Express (1) and the Lower Panorama Gondola are expected today, with no lifts expected to open before 9AM, conditions permitting, with access to Broadway, Silver Tip and Rusty's. Strong southwest winds overnight left the new snow wind-affected in exposed spots, with softer turns in sheltered pockets. There is no beginner terrain yet, and early season obstacles exist under the new snow, so please ski and ride with caution.

Conditions and Visibility: Sunny skies, lighter west-southwest winds and temperatures in the 20s to mid 30s. Expect fresh snow over a firm base, wind-packed in open areas and softer where the wind couldn't reach. Bright light all day, so grab a sunny-day lens.
Lift Status: Opening is delayed this morning, with no lifts spinning before 9 AM. Broadway Express (1) and the Lower Panorama Gondola are expected to spin today, conditions permitting.
Safety:  Early season obstacles and closures still exist. Respect all signs, ropes, and closures for your safety. If it's not open, there's a reason. It is recommended to stay on groomed terrain. Visit our Safety page for more tips. Our on-mountain emergency hotline is: 760.934.0611
Road Conditions: Be prepared for winter mountain driving and watch for icy patches. Always carry chains Check our Road Conditions page for the latest status.
_inspectorSnowReport.News: Happy Snow Day! There is 9-13 inches of new snow and more on the way next week. Expect sunny skies and light winds today. Remember to stay on groomed trails, watch for early season obstacles, and respect all ropes, closures, and signs. Enjoy the fresh snow!
_inspectorSnowReport.Alert: 9-13 inches of new snow! Ride safe and enjoy the turns!
